text: Do “silly things” intentionally. Dance a strange dance while no one sees you, make a grimace at your reflection in the mirror, sing aloud in an indecent voice... These small acts of spontaneity destroy the armor of “adulthood” and restore access to living, childlike energy. Develop the ability to be on the wave of playfulness. This state helps to live happily, avoiding unnecessary tensions, and without conflicts maintaining personal boundaries.
